name: Silverstone
blurb: Wide open sweeps across the old airfield.

texts: Silverstone was a wartime bomber airfield. The first Grand Prix here was in 1948.
In 2024 Lewis Hamilton won his ninth British Grand Prix here, the most wins any driver has had at a single circuit.
The very first Formula One World Championship race was held here, in May 1950.
Aston Martin's Formula One team is based right beside the circuit, and most of the teams are within an hour's drive, in what is called Motorsport Valley.
